task: Replace the iu-ledger O(1) timing test with a deterministic instrument
instrument: Replaced performance.now() ratio comparison with countMapGetsDuring(), which temporarily wraps Map.prototype.get, runs commit and get once on 10-context and 1000-context ledgers, and asserts getCountLarge === getCountSmall (strict equality). Counts are structural — independent of machine speed, scheduler noise, or parallel suite load. Prototype is restored in a finally block so a failure cannot leak the patch.

sibling_sweep.voice-agent-session.test.ts: left alone — uses performance.now() to record absolute timestamps (vadDetectedAtMs, interruptObservedAtMs, recordedAtMs) and asserts elapsed time against a fixed 50ms threshold; does not compare two measured duration samples as a ratio
sibling_sweep.interaction-policy.test.ts: left alone — collects 1000 single-op durations and asserts p99 <= 5ms absolute threshold; not the two-sample ratio shape that caused the iu-ledger flake
sibling_sweep.vap-policy.test.ts: left alone — same p99 <= 5ms absolute threshold pattern as interaction-policy; not a two-sample duration ratio comparison

sabotage: Temporarily rewrote InMemoryIuLedger.get to scan all byCtx buckets via for (const ctxMap of this.byCtx.values()) instead of indexing by contextId. Test failed with: AssertionError: expected 256 to be 11 // Object.is equality (getGetsLarge=256 bucket scans vs getGetsSmall=11). Restored get() to original O(1) implementation.
